description_en: Adds IP addresses to the blacklist for an Anti-DDoS Pro instance
description_zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo add-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --blacklist src_:_198.51.XX.XX_,_src_:_198.52.XX.XX --expire-time 300 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro instance.

Call the DescribeInstanceIds operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用DescribeInstanceIds查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses to add to the blacklist. This is a JSON array. Each object in the array contains the following field:

src: String. Required. The IP address to add.

You can add up to 2,000 IP addresses per request
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
src：String类型，必选，黑名单IP。
黑名单中最多支持手动添加2000个IP。多个IP地址间使用空格或换行方式分割
parameters.name: blacklist

parameters.help_en: The expiration time for the blacklist entries, in seconds. Valid values: 300 to 604800
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间，可自定义。取值范围：300~604800，单位：秒
parameters.name: expire_time

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
